scope: Phase C explicit natural-language correction suspension (no background reflection/root-cause model)
behavior: narrow explicit correction intent detection (Chinese/English phrases); ordinary discussion does not trigger
on admission, the correction targets only memory ids actually cited by the assistant in the latest completed turn (attribution.latestCited)
each cited memory entry becomes stale in the same transaction/epoch advance; recall/list/search exclude it; body is not deleted or archived
excerpts and derived candidates/versions depending on the corrected memory are purged invalidated via the existing propagation helpers
status.corrections exposes detected/applied/unresolved/failed/suspended counters; no long reflection text is written into chat
if no cited memory or another session, the correction is unresolved and nothing is mutated

realInstall.note: plugin reloaded with the correction manager; no real correction conversation was run

limitations: No background reflection/root-cause analysis: it does not compare original sources, distinguish outdated vs misunderstanding, or produce a reflection record.
No separation of verified facts vs hypotheses for correction root causes; only the user message continues through normal extraction (if any).
The chat small bar does not yet show a dedicated “memory corrected” state; only status counters change.
No cross-restart test of attribution citations: attribution is in-process and latestCited is lost on restart.
No real Host conversation/assistant marker test; unit tests use a synthetic attribution + temporary store.
Correction target scope is the latest cited turn only; ambiguous/uncited corrections remain unresolved without a chat clarification.
